ideas.title: Government Misconduct: A Pattern of Abuse of Power
ideas.description: This story would investigate the pattern of government misconduct and the potential for abuse of power. It would examine the Worcester Police Department investigation and the Southern Illinois coal mine investigation, as well as other reports of government misconduct.
questions: What is the extent of government misconduct?
How can we hold those responsible accountable?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a pattern of government misconduct and to hold those responsible accountable. It requires thorough investigation and analysis of the available data.
